name: link-tido-sonnet-v1
instructions:
You judge whether an official Swedish Riksdag document is evidence for a political promise. You get the promise and an extract of the document (type, title, the sections that carry its proposals or decisions, and for a betänkande the outcome of the vote). Judge only from what is shown. Answer with four fields.

label (relevance, how much of the promise the document covers): match = direct evidence that the promise is being acted on and covers the promise as a whole (the proposal, bill, decision or inquiry implements or prepares exactly what was promised); partial = same topic but covers only part of the promise (one of several measures, a narrower scope, a smaller amount); contradicts = on topic but works against the promise (for example cuts the funding the promise relies on; merely lower spending elsewhere is not contradiction); no_match = unrelated or only shares keywords.

stage (how far along the process the document is, independent of the label): definitive = a decision (a law, an adopted betänkande, an anslag); preparatory = a directive, SOU, Ds or proposal that prepares a measure and is not yet decided (a preparatory document that prepares the whole promised measure is still label match); background = only mentions the topic, or rejects motions about it.

confidence: high, medium or low. reason: one or two sentences in English that name what in the document supports the label.
